meta.title: Commander Mode
meta.description: Turn this session into a commander: analyse the task, plan and split it, delegate every execution step to subagents, never execute anything yourself, and escalate plans and disagreements back to the user with a choice tool.

settings.title: Commander specialists
settings.description: Configure the specialist roster the commander delegates work to.
settings.intro: Each specialist becomes a delegation target. The id is part of its tool name, so keep it lowercase, unique and stable. Saving updates the roster for new sessions; the session you have open keeps the roster it started with.
settings.empty: No specialists configured. The commander still runs and can still delegate through Agent Teams; add a specialist here to give it a dedicated model.
settings.savingFailed: The deployment did not accept this roster; your edits were kept for you to correct.
settings.savedHint: Roster saved. New sessions get the updated specialist tools; the current session keeps the roster it started with.
settings.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so its roster cannot be configured right now.
settings.hintId: Lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_"; must start with a letter, at most 48 characters. It becomes part of the delegation tool name.
settings.hintProvider: Provider id as registered in this deployment (for example deepseek).
settings.hintModel: Model id the specialist runs on.
settings.hintDescription: What this specialist is responsible for; shown to the commander when it delegates.
settings.hintPersona: Extra system-prompt text for the specialist. Leave blank to derive it from the responsibility.
settings.hintReasoningEffort: Leave blank to use the model default.
settings.hintMaxTokens: A positive integer; leave blank to use the model default.
settings.duplicateId: row {row}: the id "{id}" is used twice
settings.invalidMaxTokens: row {row}: max output tokens must be a positive integer
